summary: Frontend-only verification of Phase 7C-3 Manager Review Queue. All 10 scoped behaviours pass: reviewer-only sidebar item with live pending badge, route guard for non-reviewers (owner/groom -> /), four-eyes block on admin's sensitive seeded fixture, trainer (different reviewer) approve happy path, request-changes modal with optional note, instant badge refresh via 'owner-updates-changed', empty state, and logo non-regression. No app-level console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewQueue.jsx lines 30-41: load() and horses fetch run only on canReview-mount; no polling. Acceptable since Sidebar polls every 60s and the 'owner-updates-changed' event drives cross-page refresh. If a non-reviewer's role were upgraded mid-session, the dispatched window event isn't currently listened to by ReviewQueue itself, but since the user must navigate to the page (which triggers mount/load), this is fine.

Minor: ReviewQueue does not listen to 'owner-updates-changed' itself, so if another tab approves an item the open queue won't auto-update. Sidebar badge does refresh. Not a 7C-3 requirement; consider adding a listener for parity.
Sidebar.jsx line 115 testid generator collapses non-letters into '-' (e.g., 'Review Queue' -> 'nav-review-queue'), matches spec.

Backend 401 console errors appear only briefly during the login redirect window (e.g., /api/notifications calls firing before the auth token attaches on /login -> /). These are not 7C-3 regressions; same pattern existed before 7C-3.
